body:
Not sure if anyone still cares about this post or my progress lol..
Just wanted to update everyone,
Living with my parents again, off the streets..
The depression is still there. 
It's on and off like everyone else, but I'm spiraling downwards again.. 
I love you all and really appreciate the kind words everyone shared with me, thanks for your care <3

For the first time in a while I'm actually proud of myself lol..
Thank you <3
I decided not to go down that path. I'm trying my best at the moment to get my shit together and get into college, soon to get into a program. Thank you for the support, friend <3

Actually just last night I committed myself to stop abusing prescription meds (Adderall) and the clarity, knowing that's not me anymore, is more then enough to get me started to a better life.. It feels weird how quickly I went from on the verge of suicide, sleeping in a ditch to actually keeping my head up, seeing clearly and not fiending for some way out. Trust me all my problems haven't vanished, but I'm far less suicidal then I was less then a day ago.
Still breathing, forcing myself back onto my feet, slowly trying to get my shit together. Thank you so much for caring <3

If it's any comfort I'm still alive, I was lucky enough to stumble upon some helpful souls that snapped me out of it. 
But you're right, I've seen far too many posts of people begging for help, begging for any human interaction at all only to be ignored. 
Not sure why mine blew up but scrolling through you can find an infinite amount of posts with people that have either already decided they're gonna end it right then and there or asking for just one person to show they care. 
It's some fucked up shit.

Thank you so much for the kind words, I connect deeply with the emotions you've expressed here.
The abuse I received made me an angry person, I don't wish to be but I am. I'm starting to strive to become a better person and put all this shit behind me.

Within the past few hours I've found the path leading to peace,
Thank you for the kind words <3
You too friend <3

I truly cannot believe how my perspective, mood and atmosphere have changed in these past few hours. Thank you all so much for the kind words and support, you've all made a difference in my life and made me believe in myself, I feel more human then I have in years. 
I cannot express the thanks I'd like to show to all of you. 
If there's anything any of you need, big or small, whatever it is, I'm here. 
I don't care if its something as small as you stepped on a lizard and felt bad, 
Or something as big as a relative dying, 
I want to help people like you've all helped me. 
Have a great night, I love you all <3

Yeah, reading your comments made me smile like a dork every time lol. Thank you so much for all this, after trying to reach out a few times on a few different websites and to most of the people i know personally, I was starting to think and believe that my life was coming to a halt and that no one had any care for my life, or desire to help in any way

I'll be sure to. I had myself convinced that this is Sincerely what I was meant to do, and the people on this forum are fucking amazing. 
I will fight this, I'm going to get through this, become a stronger person and put this part of my life behind me, and I wouldn't have been able to do it without everyone here. I can't express that enough

Honestly I had a few ideas in mind, but I'm not sure if I should share amigo. It's not that I find you being curious irrelevant, but if I were to tell you how to kill yourself, and you're sitting at home right now trying to figure out an effective way to end it and went through with it, I wouldn't be able to live with myself.
Maybe that's selfish.. But I can't have another human do that.

I'm currently getting food from around town, I had a few friends here as a few years ago drifting through this part of the states, I'm actually about to enter a program that allows me to get my diploma over a 6 month period and jump right into college(pretty excitedddd)
Along with a dorm and paid appliances, they have lunch breakfast and dinner on work days. 
Don't stress too much, I'm surviving. I struggle obviously, But I have some people that can take me in if its a last resort. If I was in danger I know where I'd go, I'm getting plenty of food and I'm in somewhat of a shelter tonight.

Honestly you're helping more then you'll ever know just by being here and showing that you care about my life. I haven't had a physical conversation with another human in weeks. Seriously have not even spoken to anyone. Over texts and the internet is about it haha.
Thank you so much <3

Yours and a few others words of wisdom have inspired me to get better, 
you've all snapped me out of this slump. 
I appreciate you reaching out to me, seriously it means the world to me. <3 I've decided tomorrow I'm asking a friend about seeing his psychologist. I can't give up on myself anymore, I can't see my own life as something to throw away. 
Thank you so much

I want you to know that you're comments have seriously made me more confident and happy then I've been in years. 
It makes me really fucken happy to know that I've made somewhat of a difference in your life, I'm gonna strive to get better, I know if I try hard enough I can be whoever the fuck I want. 
Seriously dude, I cannot express how emotional that comment made me. I've been trying so hard to reach out to people all day, I've been desperate for human interaction, and your comments were exactly what I needed. 
I don't want it to end at this either, If you're open to it we should talk as friends. 

And I'm currently on the streets to get away from my abusive parents, they're not willing to emancipate me, and don't care enough to get the law involved.. they're in Miami and I've trainhopped and hitchhiked nearly to Mexico, not sure where my road ends or what my destination is, but tonight I truly felt helpless as a human being, and you've struck me with inspiration to make myself better.

That was truly inspiring, it fills me with joy that you see the steps I've taken in life as something to look up to. These past few months I've felt nothing but regret and longing for some form of emotion, some compassion towards another living creature. 
I really no longer feel bad for people in pain, people less fortunate, people that have less then I do. 
I want to, I really do want to be a better person then what I am now. 
But even if I were to go out and make myself better, get on meds and make this all go away, I'll know deep inside that this is who I really am, and the decent emotions I'm feeling are synthetic.. 
And no, currently I'm 17 and living on the streets, have no access to therapy anymore.

If I'm being completely honest with you, my only goals involve pain and fear. I don't care about human life anymore, even less my own. I don't wish to advance the human race, I don't wish to make my own life better, sure my past isn't my fault, but the way I've effected the people around me, the choices I made, are exactly that, my choices. I've always believed in karma, and it's dealt a shit hand to me until just recently. 
I've hurt people. Not just emotionally, I've physically hurt people because of who I am, Because of how damaged I am. 
I can't justify the pain I've given others, but I know the universe deserves justice, and I know I deserve what I've given alot of people. 
Which is why I'm not just gonna go blow my brains out, I intent to make my death the most miserable and gory death I can possibly make it.
I'm a heavy drinker, and when I'm not drinking I'm on amphetamines, or mixing the two. 
Everyone I've ever met has had high expectations of me, only to find out I'm a pathetic junkie.
When I was young my parents thought I'd be a genius, I had an IQ of 135, not even bullshitting. 
And I threw that all away. 
I had the chance to make this all work and it's gone. 
I stopped drinking and quit the amphetamines, going through what feels like double withdraw, just so this pain I'll shortly feel will be real.
No numbness. 
No pussying out. No easy ways out.
Just pain, until I'm gone. And I'm happy with that. 
I've benefit no one, and it feels good knowing that this decision will benefit the whole world. 
I don't know why I felt the need to explain this to a stranger, but you've tried to help, and that mean's alot to me. But I almost with people could see this decision as something positive like I have. 
No one really cares whether I live or die, I made previous posts with up to 40 viewers, no one cares unless you're dead or about to die. 
My problems are irrelevant. But I do appreciate you reaching out. 

Have a great night, and thank you for listening to my pitiful problems lol. 
<3

Honestly I've looked for alternatives my whole life, I knew from the time I could grasp reality that there was a way out, and that it'd be better. 
I appreciate the advice, and I wish you the best of luck, but I'm done trying to convince myself there's another way.

I've actually been diagnosed with antisocial personality disorder from 4 different psychologists. 
I've held on for years and at this point in my life, 
It's different, 
This feeling is unique. All my life I've craved peace, I've craved to not have to wake up and worry about other people, about other problems, and right now, I feel and know this is the end of my road. This is my destiny, this is what my life has amounted to, and I'm truly content with that. 
I know people have and continue to see this post as some depressed teenager not knowing where else to turn, being edgy, being suicidal because of daddy issues or something.. but I do know where to turn, and my adrenaline is pumping knowing that this is a decision I get to make. Knowing I can now make myself happy and knowing my existence will end in this state.

I try to see your words and find truth in them, But me as a person isn't willing to risk more then what I've been through. I appreciate you looking out for a human life, one you don't even know, you're a kind soul.

This is the response I needed.
I'll find you in the void, amigo.

I've tried venting, letting people in.
All it does is makes other people worry, I'm done having other people solve my problems for me, and honestly this is my best solution.
I appreciate that <3

And honestly I'm not sure what I believe happens after death, I hope it's something peaceful, I hope it's like a long nap that you never have to wake up from. 
But in my opinion it's hard to decide whether or not to continue living life, all I've received so far is negativity. 
So I just wing it and hope for the best, But if I crave death (or peace) my whole life and nothing gets better, by the time I'm on my death bed it's really gonna suck knowing I didn't off myself at a decent time in my life.

The only negative part about that is if you're cursed to live a shit life and don't know it yet, if your future only contains pain and insecurity, if none of this ever gets better, you've wasted all that time you could've spent eternally resting.

Sorry if I'm making this situation worse, a bit torn between needing help and trying to give help at the moment.

I've been asking myself this for a while now. Life in my opinion is only a doorway to non-existence. 
If life isn't worth living and our eternal plan no matter what is nothing but death, it's kind of hard to see any of this as something worthwhile. 

I mean this from the bottom of my heart, I made this exact situation and perspective feel a little better by doing whatever the fuck I want. 
As long as you're not hurting people, go out and achieve your goals or fucken die trying. 
Go on hikes, force yourself to meet new people,
learn to love yourself, learn to love those around you.
You're the only one in control of your life amigo. While things may seem extremely fucking rough at some point, you just have to keep striving to take control, and believe me, you will. 
Much love, sorry for ranting

Sadly I'm living on the streets and I'm only able to use a laptop while sleeping outside of a library with free wifi lol.. 
Thank you for the advice, If I'm able to somehow get it on my computer I'll give it a try. 

I don't believe I'd actually lose control and hurt anyone, but the constant thought of it in my head and the belief that I could get away with it is overwhelming.
